findings.title: Cash reporting and verification demand the full total after a deposit
findings.scenario: A completed EGP 200 order has an acknowledged EGP 100 deposit and EGP 100 cash remainder. The cook reports the correctly collected EGP 100 cash.
findings.expected: The cash report has zero discrepancy and finance can verify EGP 100 against the immutable cash obligation.
findings.actual: The report records a negative EGP 100 discrepancy and marks the obligation DISPUTED. Verification rejects EGP 100 because it also requires the full EGP 200 total. The cook form defaults to that full total.
findings.evidence: OrderService.placeOnce inserts cash_obligation.amount_minor as q.totalMinor() - q.depositMinor(). CashService.java:96-106 instead calculates discrepancy against customer_order.total_minor; lines 127-150 use that total again for verification. apps/operations-web/src/cook/Orders.tsx:182 initializes the report amount from order.total.
findings.suggested_fix: Use cash_obligation.amount_minor for reporting and verification, and payment.remainder for the cook form default. Handle zero-remainder orders explicitly.
findings.repro_test: Add an integration scenario placing a 50% deposit order, acknowledging receipt, completing it, reporting the remainder, and verifying that remainder. Assert zero discrepancy and VERIFIED cash state. Not executed.

findings.title: Staff grants become usable without MFA
findings.scenario: An active account with finance.verify or support.case authenticates using a password-only session or bearer token with no MFA claims, then accesses its staff endpoints.
findings.expected: BR-007 and the permission specification require MFA for staff sessions, with recent step-up additionally required for high-risk actions.
findings.actual: AccountMapper grants every active database permission without checking assurance. Most staff controllers check only those permissions, so password-only authentication can read support conversations and verify cash reports.
findings.evidence: AccountMapper.java:49-50 unconditionally adds active permission authorities; assurance claims are merely copied at lines 56-62. SecurityConfiguration's API chains require ACCOUNT_ACTIVE without a staff MFA guard. StaffCaseController.java:31 requires only PERM_support.case. CashController.java:70 requires only PERM_finance.verify. StaffAssurance is invoked only by selected endpoint annotations.
findings.suggested_fix: Require a validated MFA assertion before granting or exercising any staff authority. Keep recent authentication age checks as an additional requirement for sensitive actions.
findings.repro_test: Authenticate an account holding support.case and finance.verify with claims lacking MFA. Assert denial for staff case reads and cash verification; assert access with valid MFA and appropriate grants. Cover both web and bearer chains. Not executed.

findings.title: Reusable upload URL can replace an approved private document
findings.scenario: A cook uploads a clean document and completes scanning, then reuses the still-valid ten-minute PUT URL to replace it with different bytes of the same length and content type.
findings.expected: Approved document reads return exactly the bytes that passed checksum, content inspection, and malware scanning.
findings.actual: The PUT signature binds the key, type, and length but no content checksum or create-only condition. Approval retains the upload key, and private reads sign that same mutable key. Completion returns immediately for an APPROVED row, so replacement bytes are served without inspection.
findings.evidence: S3ObjectStorage.java:48-50 signs PUT without checksum or overwrite protection. MediaService.java:121 issues the upload URL; lines 132-133 skip verification for approved media; lines 273-274 generate approved document read URLs using row.privateKey().
findings.suggested_fix: Bind uploads to the declared checksum and ensure approved reads reference immutable verified bytes, using a separate protected object or a verified immutable object version. Prevent upload tickets from overwriting approved content.
findings.repro_test: Against the configured S3-compatible storage, upload and approve a clean synthetic document, overwrite it through the original ticket before expiry, then read it as a reviewer. Assert overwrite rejection or retrieval of the original verified bytes. Not executed.
